facts.title: A Difficult Path
facts.location: Shadow Priest Sarvis (30.8, 66.2), then Aramis Hammerhand (31.0, 66.2), Deathknell chapel
facts.note: Level 1. Read the Consecrated Scroll, then meet Aramis. Needs The Mindless Ones first. 40 XP.

facts.title: Rediscovering the Light
facts.note: Level 2. Use Holy Light on five Injured Deathguard beside the chapel (32.0, 64.4), then return to Aramis before leaving for Night's Web Hollow. 85 XP. Healing others hurts you for a while; that is the quest's theme.

facts.title: Coming to Terms
facts.location: Aramis Hammerhand (31.0, 66.2); Frightened Paladin in the hills west of the chapel (27.6, 63.8)
facts.note: Level 4. Finish it before leaving Deathknell. 180 XP.

facts.title: Continue Your Training
facts.location: Aramis Hammerhand, then Shari Stilwell in Brill (60.4, 51.9)
facts.note: Level 4. Follow the road east to Brill. 90 XP. Shari trains from level 6.

facts.title: Murlocs at the Gates
facts.note: Level 7. Murlocs are at about 13.8, 53.1. Turn in to Breton, who then gives Touring the Grounds. The keep is also called Tyr's Watch.

facts.title: Touring the Grounds
facts.location: Breton Samuels; Hilda the Breaker (22.0, 47.1), Jorin Croge, Ander Solliden (about 25.3, 50.5); turn in to Danitha Morr (22.1, 44.7)
facts.note: Level 8. Four conversations in and around the keep, then Danitha upstairs.

facts.title: The Tarnished
facts.note: Level 9. Kill 8 Tarnished Drudges and 6 Tarnished Zealots, and Rudolph Gelhardt upstairs in the house for his head.

facts.title: A Token of Good Faith
facts.location: Danitha Morr; Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, Undercity Royal Quarter (58.0, 91.8)
facts.note: Level 9. Deliver Rudolph Gelhardt's Head to Sylvanas, then return to Danitha. The next chain, A Lesson in Divinity, starts at level 12 (keep ten Linen Cloth and the Symbol of Life).
